tools.name: research_context
tools.description: Retrieve project evidence, failures and provenance (untrusted research data).

tools.name: research_focus_candidates
tools.description: List prior claims/failures available as new attention targets; not a search optimizer.

tools.name: audit_research_shift
tools.description:
Audit against sourced frontier constraints; never decide mathematical truth.

proposed_operation: mechanism, intent (experiment/transformation/proof),
premises[], mathematical_properties[], testable_consequence, required_evidence[].
verification_plan: method and failure_condition. preserved_properties maps
point_value, analytic_function, observables, source_provenance and
rule_applicability to separate claim/evidence_refs objects. Missing or
semantic evidence returns REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_REVIEW. Cosmetic names do
not change the structured fingerprint. Legacy text-only calls remain advisory.
evidence_roles maps cited event IDs to role and reason. Diagnostic or
label_error roles require a scoped local-operator disposition; the
caller cannot clear adverse evidence just by changing its role label.

tools.name: research_frontier
tools.description: Read current obligations and event-backed constraints before choosing a research move.

tools.name: research_obligation_history
tools.description: Read immutable obligation versions, including closure and reopening grounds.

tools.name: research_move_history
tools.description: Read immutable status/audit history and current effective execution permission.

tools.name: propose_research_policy
tools.description: Request an explicit human-approved policy change; does not apply it.

tools.name: service_health
tools.description: Integrity and audit-chain check.

tools.name: research_normalize_preview
tools.description: Read-only source-preserving004.1. C4 is explanation only; no grants or audit-log writes.

tools.name: research_native_preview
tools.description: Bounded source replay with I006.2/optional007.2 and unchanged T; never executes an external experiment.

tools.name: record_result
tools.description: Record hypothesis, failed check, counterexample or proof candidate; verified status is prohibited.

tools.name: record_research_move
tools.description:
Save a deduplicated proposal and its separate audit; never activate it.

move requires active_frontier_id, active_frontier_version, scope,
parent_event_ids and the structured audit fields. Scope must match the
active obligation for experiment authorization. Cosmetic names do not
create another move. A request key cannot be reused with different data.
Hard audit failures are saved as REJECTED with no execution permission.

tools.name: transition_research_move
tools.description:
Explicit lifecycle decision; only a currently audited bounded experiment can activate.

complete requires result(outcome, summary, optional data), reason and
at least one existing project-local event:N evidence_ref. FAILURE,
INCONCLUSIVE and ERROR are valid outcomes; no outcome verifies
mathematics. Changed obligation versions require audit_research_move.
Rejected, abandoned or completed proposals carry no execution permission.

tools.name: audit_research_move
tools.description: Persist a fresh audit against current obligation versions; never activate execution.

tools.name: research_obligation_create
tools.description: Create a versioned research obligation. Closure records research state, not a proof.

tools.name: research_obligation_update
tools.description: Append an obligation version; reopening requires explicit grounds and new source/evidence.

tools.name: record_transformation_contract
tools.description:
Record source→operation→result and create five OPEN preservation obligations.

preservation must contain point_value, analytic_function, observables,
source_provenance and rule_applicability. Each entry needs statement and
optional evidence_refs. A reference does not establish preservation.

tools.name: attend
tools.description: Persist attention shift, linked to prior finding within same project.

tools.name: interpret
tools.description: Persist a new UNVERIFIED interpretation; claims are not accepted as proven.

tools.name: research_cycle_preview
tools.description: 017 source-owned004/I/T preview; legacy011 adapter remains compatible. No grants.

tools.name: research_cycle_precommit
tools.description: Persist a source-bound proposal only. Local owner must audit/activate separately.

tools.name: research_cycle_validate
tools.description: Read-only typed semantic validator. A premise event never completes an engine claim.

tools.name: research_novelty_snapshot
tools.description: Use server journal/latest committed feedback; caller memory does not grant novelty.

tools.name: research_cycle_next
tools.description: Server-owned next proposal or explicit stop/wait. Never activates, measures or commits.

tools.name: research_cycle_history
tools.description: Persistent source, status, receipts and applicability versions across clients/restarts.

tools.name: research_source_contract
tools.description: Registered immutable data envelope, inspection limits and no executable capabilities.

tools.name: research_contract
tools.description: Read current research principles before exploring or proposing a new theory.

tools.name: dav_register_adapter
tools.description:
Register allowlisted CA/GraphBits/conditional-Gate6 or capacity-one reaction_network. No code/path input.

Writes only the isolated DAV store. Registration/audit never grants research execution.
A projected descriptor retains raw full states; audit may forbid a quotient interpretation.

tools.name: dav_observe
tools.description: Observe bounded original states and all operation outputs. Observations never imply a full-world proof.

tools.name: dav_check_law
tools.description:
Check a bound typed formula. proved is only adapter-relative finite/encoded semantics; never scientific verified.

Explicit states ALWAYS mean sampled evidence. Complete enumeration is determined internally.
Equality scope full_state/observation is explicit. Default computation writes no certificate.

tools.name: dav_generate_candidates
tools.description: Deterministic paged symbolic equation-implication proposals; no proof or neural policy implied.

tools.name: dav_reduce_library
tools.description:
Reduce checked laws by exact premise/conclusion vectors and subsumption; not a minimal axiom basis.

Partial candidate search is marked search_complete=false. Sample relations remain empirical.
Explicit persist saves one append-only library with its scope and evidence vectors.

tools.name: dav_find_counterexample
tools.description: Return a concrete raw-state violation and full replay steps, or an explicitly scoped undecided/proved result.

tools.name: dav_audit_adapter
tools.description: Audit total deterministic builtin semantics and projected observational congruence; return actual paired witness.

tools.name: dav_export_evidence
tools.description: Read project-local immutable evidence and effective binding validity; no grant, verification or raw DB exposure.

tools.name: research_autonomy_ingest
tools.description:
Supply scoped source/model inputs once; all computational research stages then run automatically.

livingmath-artifact/1 accepts raw UTF-8 or pinned source snapshot, rights,
typed008/1 reaction_network and bounded budgets; the server builds models.
Optional interpretation="general011" enables addressed source relations,
independent source critique and named observation projections. It uses
an owner-configured model; availability is explicit in bridge_system_status.
Declared facts are not independent empirical verification. A new relevant source
automatically revalidates waiting/completed cases, preserving adverse history.
Existing native/physical operator permissions remain separate.

tools.name: research_autonomy_status
tools.description: Observe automatically running/waiting cases; no advance, audit or activation calls are necessary.

tools.name: research_autonomy_control
tools.description: Interrupt/resume a computational case. This is not a manual stage-advance or mathematical permission tool.

tools.name: research_autonomy_history
tools.description: Page the complete immutable lifecycle, including failed proposals, RCA, input requests and checker record IDs.

tools.name: bridge_system_status
tools.description: Read unified version/components and the exact capabilities actually installed on this endpoint.

tools.name: bridge_catalog
tools.description: List registered source snapshots. Source IDs select allowlisted data, never a path/module or arbitrary archive.

tools.name: bridge_inspect
tools.description:
Inspect real source addresses, original schema-valid witness pairs or the preserved public ALCH006 model.

Archived numeric event IDs in model provenance are historical only, not current execution grounds.
Text/document references do not become executable invariants. All model claims remain unverified.

tools.name: bridge_validate_records
tools.description:
Validate full records against the actual reviewed SUTI schema and return witnesses of information lost by projection.

Omit records to replay the original003/004 source-bound pair. Schema admission, observed equality
and full source equality remain distinct; no runtime permission or global field-independence claim.

tools.name: bridge_run_alchemy
tools.description:
Start the real public alchemy case in its own QA project with one call; research continues automatically.

Imports source-bound requirements, repairs the insufficient P observer, and rechecks the original
Gate6 implication without adding P⇒Q. Original RH/FTL/canonical events and ALCH006 files are not modified.
Repeated same request_key does not create another run. Inspect research_autonomy_status(project).

tools.name: assurance_contract
tools.description: Get exact v0.1 schemas, a valid manual proposal and finite assurance boundaries.

tools.name: assurance_project_new
tools.description: Create a separate private assurance workspace; no changes to legacy SQLite events.

tools.name: assurance_source_add
tools.description: Import exact SourceSnapshot JSON bytes and explicit publication policy; see assurance_contract.

tools.name: assurance_task_import
tools.description: Import a typed task as DRAFT. Explicit exact scope/assumptions review is required before check.

tools.name: assurance_task_review
tools.description: Explicitly confirm the exact imported task scope and assumptions. Does not verify the claim.

tools.name: assurance_candidate_import
tools.description: Retain an untrusted manual/model proposal, including malformed or false raw claims. No checking or grant.

tools.name: assurance_check
tools.description: Append a deterministic scoped decision and actual witnesses using the unchanged pinned core.

tools.name: assurance_report
tools.description: Read all checked claims, exact assumptions/scope, source SHA/spans, witnesses and negative results.

tools.name: assurance_export
tools.description: Return a data-only immutable bundle as base64. Source bytes require both rights and audience permission.

tools.name: assurance_replay
tools.description: Offline replay of a data-only bundle; no network, OAuth refresh, model or subprocess inside replay.

tools.name: assurance_doctor
tools.description: Read the actual installed core identities and scope of this developer preview.

tools.name: semantic_contract
tools.description: Exact semantic schemas, source scope, workflow and epistemic boundaries. Existing assurance tools stay unchanged.

tools.name: semantic_source
tools.description: Pin author/title/edition/editorial_source_url/edition_status over an existing source_ref and confirm limited task scope.

tools.name: semantic_draft
tools.description: Generate a real hosted initial reading, or import an explicitly untrusted client proposal. No truth/execution grant.

tools.name: semantic_revise
tools.description: Retain the frozen parent and add a revised reading with rationale, competing interpretations and exact lineage.

tools.name: semantic_compare
tools.description: Finite declared-field/Q comparison with a source-bound counter-witness; semantic world questions remain conjectures.

tools.name: semantic_report
tools.description: All reading versions, exact anchors, alternatives, revision edges, failed raw proposals and actual model receipts.

tools.name: semantic_withdraw
tools.description: Append withdrawal status and reason while retaining the original reading and every negative result.

tools.name: semantic_export
tools.description: Data-only research ZIP; publication rights apply to source bytes, prompts, quote envelopes and anchors alike.

tools.name: semantic_replay
tools.description: Replay an immutable export by SHA within its project; keeps large ZIP bytes outside bounded HTTP requests.

tools.name: white_star_status
tools.description: Read exact schemas, project-registration workflow, readiness/limits, frozen kernel hashes and actual Bridge backend. Native SUTI is NOT_EXECUTED.

tools.name: white_star_explore
tools.description: Сначала зарегистрируйте project через assurance_project_new(project, request_key). Белая звезда: сохраните UTF-8 текст и явную LLM-разметку concepts/coordinates/evidence; выполните один bounded поиск. Затем inspect decoder и record_interpretation. При PROJECT_NOT_FOUND зарегистрируйте тот же project и повторите исходный request_key/request. Исходный алгоритм, без reranking.

request.title: Proposed White Star request; semantic and byte-limit checks are additionally required

tools.name: white_star_inspect
tools.description: Read immutable run pages (default64,max128). decoder may require artifact chunks. export returns private ZIP base64 chunks; concatenate in order. No new search.

tools.name: white_star_record_interpretation
tools.description: Save the calling LLM’s readings with actual frame IDs, exact source evidence, added assumptions, alternatives and INTERPRETATION claim atoms. No server LLM or verification.

tools.name: white_star_validate_model
tools.description: Check one registered reading/claim mapping within3 supported exact rational matrix families. CHECKED_INSTANCE certifies only the concrete algebra; counterexamples return REJECTED. Other families UNSUPPORTED_MODEL.

tools.name: semantic_compare_runs
tools.description: Read two actual saved runs. MATCHED_INPUT requires identical whole frozen common snapshot, not just source SHA. Report costs/projection boundaries; never call a model or declare a winner.

tools.name: semantic_run_frozen
tools.description: Execute actual existing SemanticBridge/source assurance on a saved common_snapshot_ref from White Star. No new extraction, no coordinates, no native SUTI or invented relations. Select decoder slots explicitly.

tools.name: white_star_replay
tools.description: Recompute one private data-only export by SHA in its own project. Fixed isolated worker, unchanged numerical kernel, existing assurance checks, no LLM/network/OAuth.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_explore
tools.description: Register project with assurance_project_new first. Execute symbolic_v1 full token histories, exact SP/alpha witnesses, bounded local UDAV/CAD search. No 2D encoder, server LLM or verification. See bridge_system_status.symbolic_v1 for exact schema and limits.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_inspect
tools.description: Read immutable symbolic run pages and exact source spans. comparison requires compare_run_id in the same project; diagnostics exposes bounded local saturation. Views: operations, observations, claims, grammar, evaluation, history, states, source, report, manifest, checks, input, summary. Private export returns ordered base64 chunks. Large records explicitly require artifact chunks.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_replay
tools.description: Recompute one private symbolic data-only bundle by SHA in its own project. Exact installed operation binding, complete source/DAG audit, bounded isolated worker. No LLM/network or code execution from ZIP.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_complex_analyze
tools.description: Construct/check finite positional SP rewrite 2-complex N=2..10, exact F2 boundaries and independent path-coherence certificate. Or import only actual saved same-project operations. No pi1 claim from H1 alone. Create project first with assurance_project_new.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_complex_inspect
tools.description: Read immutable extension summary/sections with bounded pagination, source spans, exact references and private data-only export. Oversized records require artifact chunks; nothing is silently truncated.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_complex_verify
tools.description: Independently check stored finite complex and optional owned certificate_ref/typed replacement. Returns CHECKED_INSTANCE, REJECTED or NOT_PROVED with failed obligations; no execution grant.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_dataset_store
tools.description: Store a private typed train/query dataset or bounded parts collection with SHA, rights and exact source spans. Queries MUST NOT contain labels; collection parts are same-project issued refs.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_observer_synthesize
tools.description: Fit on private train_ref, seal, then predict queries-only predict_ref. Audit BUILTIN versus executed operator-derived features, effective ablation, contradictions, context UNKNOWN and pairwise abstentions. No unique grammar/semantic verification.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_observer_inspect
tools.description: Read immutable extension summary/sections with bounded pagination, source spans, exact references and private data-only export. Oversized records require artifact chunks; nothing is silently truncated.

tools.name: white_star_symbolic_extension_replay
tools.description: Recompute an owned data-only complex/observer export with installed exact binding, source hashes, independent checker and journal chain. No ZIP code, network or arbitrary paths.
